title: 第397章 浪翻云的传讯与天罗之围第396章 天仙之威与下界来讯
lines: 姬老在议会侧室接见了江寒。
他把天罗城的全部档案摊在桌面上给江寒看。
天罗城是人族在上界的第二聚居点——很小，总人口不到轩辕界的十分之一，主要居民是从各下界飞升上来但接引台被神魔干扰导致落点偏移的飞升者。
他们落错了地方落到了轩辕界光幕覆盖范围之外，被天罗城当时仅剩的几名人族老修士收容，渐渐形成了一个小据点。
天罗城有自己微弱的独立的护城光幕——以一座废弃的上古阵眼残骸为核心勉强运转，比轩辕界的青铜塔弱了不知多少个量级。
两个月前天罗城最后一批传讯玉简送到轩辕界。
内容极短：魔军兵临城下，守城阵眼只剩最后一层光幕。城内能战者约五百人出头，伤者已过半。
领军的魔族将领是一名金仙巅峰——名为“魇”，是黑渊裂隙战将序列中排行第十七的那位。三十年前屠灭西线边墙外小镇的那个魇。
“议会当时表决结果是派了一支两百人的中型援军。但在途中穿越陨神平原东侧缓冲带时被神族巡逻队拦截——神族以‘擅入神族势力缓冲区’为由要求援军改道。
改道需要多绕将近一倍的时间。援军赶到的前一天天罗城第一层外城墙已被魔军攻破。
援军在护城河对岸试图突破魔军包围时被魇本人率两个副将级别的魔将正面打退，损失过半，带队的天仙巅峰队长战死。”
姬老将最后一份传讯玉简推到江寒面前。“之后天罗城再无音讯。
我跟你实话实说：议会这边的隐忍派和投降派已经在私下达成了默契，把天罗城划为‘战后协商议题’——翻译成白话就是等它沦陷后跟魔族谈判时用来减损的筹码。现在你要去救那里的人。
我拦不住你，也不想劝你别去。
但我要提醒你三件事：第一，神族不会因为你这次是去救人就不拦你——他们不关心你救的是谁。
第二，魇的修为在你之上，金仙巅峰。跟你之前在边墙斩的那头深渊魔龙是两码事。
第三，议会内部那个‘归墟’如果知道你带队外出救人，可能会把你的路线提前透露给神族或魔族。”
江寒把玉简推回给姬老。“批准还是不批准？”
姬老沉默了片刻。
然后他提笔在批文上写了几个字。
“批准。但议会不派正规军——不能给神族落下‘人族军队擅自越境’的口实。
你们以个人志愿者名义行动。后勤物资由议会从应急储备里抽调一批但不记官方名册。
另：如果真把天罗城的幸存者救回来，带到我这里来——那时候投降派再跟我提‘维持现状’这四个字，我就把一长串的幸存者名单给他们念一遍。”
他从抽屉中取出一份旧地图摊开。
“天罗城位于轩辕界东北方向，直线距离约数千里。途中有神族太虚天域的巡逻缓冲带、一小道魔族黑渊裂隙的外溢影响区、以及一段无人缓冲地。
最安全的路线不是直线——是往东绕然后折北，多花一天但避开神族正面巡查。
路上的神族巡逻队如果发现了不能留活口——不能给他们往回报信的机会。
出发前去找欧冶子，领一批器阁新研制的灵息遮掩罩——涂在轻甲上能降低灵力外溢至少四成。聊胜于无。”
江寒起身。
走之前姬老又叫住了他。
“这次去天罗城，把浪翻云带回来。
他在洞庭湖帮我们打过老魔。他的覆雨剑在人间的战功在上界的功德碑上还没来得及刻——先补上再死。”
content_en:
Mr. Ji met Jiang Han in the side room of the parliament.
He spread all the files of Tianluo City on the table and showed them to Jiang Han.
Tianluo City is the second settlement of the human race in the upper realm - it is very small, with a total population less than one-tenth of Xuanyuan Realm. The main residents are ascendants who ascended from various lower realms, but the landing platform was interfered by gods and demons, causing the landing point to shift.
They fell into the wrong place and fell outside the coverage of Xuanyuan World's light curtain. They were taken in by the few remaining old human monks in Tianluo City and gradually formed a small stronghold.
Tianluo City has its own weak and independent city-protecting light curtain - it barely operates with the remains of an abandoned ancient formation eye as its core, which is several orders of magnitude weaker than the bronze tower in Xuanyuan World.
Two months ago, the last batch of jade slips from Tianluo City were delivered to Xuanyuan Realm.
The content is very short: The demon army is approaching the city, and only the last layer of light curtain is left in the defensive formation. There are about five hundred capable warriors in the city, and more than half of them are injured.
The demon general who leads the army is a peak golden immortal named "Nama", who is the seventeenth ranked general in the Black Abyss Rift general sequence. The monster that massacred the small town outside the Western Front's border wall thirty years ago.
"The parliament voted at that time to send a medium-sized reinforcement force of two hundred people. However, it was intercepted by the Protoss patrol while crossing the buffer zone on the east side of the Meteor God Plain. The Protoss requested that the reinforcements be diverted on the grounds of 'trespassing into the buffer zone of the Protoss forces'.
The diversion takes nearly twice as long. The day before the reinforcements arrived, the first outer wall of Tianluo City had been breached by the demon army.
When the reinforcements tried to break through the siege of the demon army on the other side of the moat, they were repelled head-on by two demon generals at the deputy general level led by Nightmare himself. More than half of them were lost, and the leader of the team, the peak immortal captain, died in the battle. "
Mr. Ji pushed the last jade slip in front of Jiang Han. “There was no news from Tianluo City after that.
Let me tell you the truth: the forbearance faction and the capitulation faction on the parliament side have reached a tacit agreement in private, classifying Tianluo City as a "post-war negotiation issue" - translated into vernacular, it is a bargaining chip used to reduce losses when negotiating with the demons after its fall. Now you have to save the people there.
I can't stop you, and I don't want to persuade you not to go.
But I want to remind you three things: First, the gods will not stop you just because you are going to save someone this time - they don't care who you save.
Secondly, Nightmare's cultivation level is above yours, the peak of Golden Immortal. It's completely different from the abyss dragon you killed on the side wall before.
Third, if the "Guixu" within the council knew that you were leading a team to rescue people, he might reveal your route to the gods or demons in advance. "
Jiang Han pushed the jade slip back to Mr. Ji. "Approval or disapproval?"
Mr. Ji was silent for a moment.
Then he picked up a pen and wrote a few words on the approval document.
"Approve. But the parliament will not send regular troops - we cannot give the Gods an excuse for 'human troops to cross the border without permission'.
You act as individual volunteers. Logistics supplies are drawn from the emergency reserve by the parliament but are not recorded in the official roster.
Another: If the survivors of Tianluo City are really rescued and brought to me - then the capitulationists will mention the words 'maintain the status quo' to me, and I will read them a long list of survivors. "
He took an old map out of a drawer and spread it out.
"Tianluo City is located in the northeast of Xuanyuan Realm, about several thousand miles away in a straight line. On the way there are the patrol buffer zone of the Taixu Heavenly Domain of the Gods, a small spillover area of the Demon Race's Black Abyss Fissure, and an uninhabited buffer zone.
The safest route isn't a straight line - it's to go east and then north, taking an extra day but avoiding direct protoss patrols.
If the protoss patrol on the road finds out, they will not be left alive - they will not be given the opportunity to send a message back.
Before setting off, go to Ou Yezi and get a batch of the spiritual breath masks newly developed by Qige - applied to light armor, it can reduce the leakage of spiritual energy by at least 40%. Better than nothing. "
Jiang Han stood up.
Before leaving, Mr. Ji stopped him again.
“This time, go to Tianluo City and bring Lang Fanyun back.
He helped us fight the old devil in Dongting Lake. The merits of his Rain-Covering Sword in the human world have not yet been engraved on the merit monument in the upper world - he must first make up for it before he dies. "
title_en: Chapter 397 The message from Lang Fanyun and the siege of Tianluo Chapter 396 The power of the gods and the message from the lower world
